note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. A and B differ only in the supplied alteration mark on B's seal strip; no consequence of the mark is drawn (nothing about tampering, admissibility, validity or custody), no winner and no score. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts, comparisonLabels.
